blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱489.85 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the ₱15 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. According to the PCSO results, the Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw produced the winning combination 09-26-10-04-02-47, with a jackpot prize of ₱489.85 million. No ticket matched all six winning numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 draw yielded the winning combination 45-39-38-13-05-21, carrying a jackpot prize of ₱15 million. No bettor won the top prize.
